texts.zh:
我们解码收集自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们似乎完全不具有对于我们[This.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]物种而言自然而然的个体概念。事实上，单个[This.ContactCountry.GetAdj]“[This.ContactCountry.GetIndividualName]”没有自由意志和任何思想，他们不过是“[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]”的走卒罢了。他们是在如此严格的控制之下，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]推测[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的进化依赖于集体智慧，没有了集体智慧他们便无法生存。
texts.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

Remarkably, they appear to completely lack the concept of individuality that is inherent in the [This.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] species. Indeed, the individual [This.ContactCountry.GetAdj] "[This.ContactCountry.GetIndividualName]" has no free will or thought whatsoever and is a mere pawn of the "[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]". Far from chafing under such tight control, our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] speculate that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have evolved to depend on this collective intelligence and would not be able to survive without it.

label.zh: 我们应该研究他们——把从他们那学到的这套用在我们自己的工人上！
label.en: We should study them - and apply the findings to our own workers!

label.zh: 有意思的物种。我们必须进一步研究这样一个物种是怎样的。
label.en: A fascinating species. We must find out how such a phenomenon is possible.

label.zh: 我们会把他们清理干净。
